question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

She was **not enough tall **to play basketball.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "not enough tall" is grammatically incorrect because the adjective "tall" should precede "enough" in this construction.
 
• In English, the correct structure is "not + adjective + enough" for proper sentence formation.
 
• The correct phrase should be "not tall enough" to convey the intended meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She was not tall enough to play basketball."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "too short"** – Although grammatically correct, this option changes the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "not tall"** – This option is incomplete and does not convey the proper comparison or degree.
 
• **Option 3: "very short"** – This option changes the meaning and does not fit the context of the sentence.
